instruction: I am using Ubuntu. Please set GIMP as the default image viewer for my system.

metadata.explanation: Task variation that sets GIMP as the default image viewer. Uses custom getter get_default_image_viewer__ae568cb6 which checks image MIME types (image/png, image/jpeg, etc.) using xdg-mime query. Evaluates that the default image viewer includes 'gimp.desktop'.
metadata.verification: The getter queries the most common image MIME type default handlers using xdg-mime. The metric check_include_exclude verifies that 'gimp.desktop' appears in the result, confirming GIMP is set as the default image viewer.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly uses xdg-mime to query default image handlers on Ubuntu
Comprehensive coverage of 15 common image MIME types (png, jpeg, gif, bmp, svg, webp, etc.)
Smart use of Counter to find most common application across all image MIME types handles Ubuntu's per-MIME-type default system
Metric check_include_exclude correctly verifies 'gimp.desktop' is in the result string
Expected value 'gimp.desktop' is the correct desktop entry name for GIMP
Complete coverage: instruction has one requirement (set GIMP as default), evaluator checks that one requirement
State is accessible and persistent (system defaults don't require postconfig)
Data flow is correct: xdg-mime query → Counter aggregation → substring check
